feed.purchased_for: JAKE-FIB-TIMEFRAME hourly unblock; no further purchase made

grid_rule.bar_label: start of interval, UTC hour aligned (verified two ways: 15:00 bar close within ~1bp of the official daily close; 13:00 bar on 2025-04-09 contains the 13:18 ET tariff-pause move)
grid_rule.kept: whole vendor hours fully inside the regular session -> 10:00..15:00 ET (6 bars)
grid_rule.limitation_opening_half_hour: no 09:30-10:00 bar exists on this grid: opening half hour is not tradable and every next-open fill is at 10:00 ET at the earliest (30 min lag, all six configs)
grid_rule.limitation_short_bar: no partial bars, so the §3.3 short_bar diagnostic is degenerate; replaced by a per-hour signal distribution and a post-hoc no-last-bar-entry rerun, both labelled diagnostics

hourly_data.cross_source_note: levels are aligned: after mapping the single-venue tape onto the snapshot's adjusted scale with the split table, the median close difference is a few basis points on every symbol. High/low containment is 72-87%: the venue's own extremes are narrower than the consolidated tape's, so intraday ranges are slightly understated. That is a property of single-venue OHLCV, quoted here rather than repaired by borrowing another vendor's highs.
hourly_data.degraded_flag_note: Databento's per-day degraded flag is not present in the CSV or the manifest, so it cannot be read offline. 2020-04-06 was checked explicitly: 6/6 regular bars for all nine symbols and volume within normal range, so no symptom of it appears in this grid. Days with visible symptoms are listed in thin_volume_days / sessions_missing_all_symbols instead of being dropped.

_fixed_recost_A00.note: multiplicative recost of the recorded turnover; identical to a full re-run only if the path is unchanged
